newsitem.title: USA: General Instrument gets cable modem deal.
newsitem.headline: General Instrument gets cable modem deal.

text.p: General Instrument Corp's NextLevel Satellite Data Networks Group said Monday it has been selected to provide its SURFboard cable modems and associated network for @Home Network.
NextLevel will provide the equipment to cable operators for delivery of the @Home Internet and multimedia service over the cable television system.

Comcast Corp will be the first operator to use the SURFboard modems for the @Home service, General Instrument said. It said Comcast signed a letter of intent for an initial 5,000 modems, and potentially up to 50,000.
General Instrument said Comcast will conduct a trial of the SURFboard modems and expects to launch a high-speed data service later this year in Philadelphia.

The SURFboard cable modem network provides high-speed data services such as connection to the Internet from a users' personal computer over a cable TV channel. Data is sent from the PC, however, via telephone connection, alllowing the modems to be used in just about any cable TV system without an upgrade to two-way cable.
@Home's investors include Comcast, Tele-Communications Inc and Cox Communications Inc.
